camel_example: aliyun alb ListAcls --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --ResourceGroupId 'rg-atstuj3rtopty0000' --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --AclIds.1 'acl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000' --AclNames.1 'test-acl' --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value product --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the access control lists (ACLs) in a region
description_zh: 查询某一个地域的访问控制列表
kebab_example: aliyun alb list-acls --acl-ids acl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --acl-names test-acl --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtopty0000 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 50 --tag Value=product Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAcls

parameters.help_en: Filter access control lists (ACLs) by ACL ID. You can specify at most 20 ACL IDs in each call
parameters.help_zh: 根据ACL ID来过滤查找ACL列表。一次最多支持查询20个ACL ID
parameters.name: acl_ids

parameters.help_en: The ACL names. You can specify up to 10 ACL names in each call
parameters.help_zh: ACL名称列表。一次最多支持查询10个ACL名称
parameters.name: acl_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can filter the query results based on the specified ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，根据设置的资源组ID来过滤
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.

If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. This parameter is optional. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，此参数为可选参数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value

AclStatus.description_en:
The status of the ACL. Valid values:

Creating: The network ACL is being created.

Available: The network ACL is available.

Configuring
AclStatus.description_zh:
ACL状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Available：正常可用状态。
Configuring：配置中

AddressIPVersion.description_en: The IP version of the ACL. Only IPv4 may be returned

ConfigManagedEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether configuration management is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
ConfigManagedEnabled.description_zh:
配置管理开关。取值：

true：开启配置管理。

false：未开启配置管理

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the ACL was created. The follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Key.description_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://

Value.description_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of network ACLs returned. This parameter is optional. Valid values: 1 to 100. If this parameter is not set, the default value 20 is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，此参数为可选参数，取值1~100。参数传入为空时，默认值为20
MaxResults.title_en: 本次查询返回记录数量
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次查询返回记录数量

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, it indicates that no next query is to be sent.

If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
